question.text: A parallel beam of monochromatic light of wavelength <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5000</mn><mo> </mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mover></math> is incident normally on a single narrow slit of width <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>001</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mm</mi></math>. The light is focused by convex lens on screen, placed on its focal plane. The first minima will be formed for the angle of diffraction of ______ (degree).

solution.text:
The condition for the first minima in the single slit diffraction experiment can be written as

asinθ=λ   ...1

Equation (1) implies that

sinθ=λa=5000×10-101×10-6=12

⇒θ=30°
